Office Manager

Location: Northern Territory
Employment Type: Full-time (38 hours per week)
Salary: $80,000-$85,000 per annum + superannuation

About Us

Coral Coast Distributors (Cairns) Pty Ltd is a retail and distribution business servicing regional and remote communities across the Northern Territory, Western Australia, and Queensland.

Our operations span multiple locations, requiring strong administrative coordination, compliance, and internal systems management to support retail, warehouse, and management teams.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Office Manager to oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of our Northern Territory business. This is a senior support role responsible for coordinating office functions, supervising clerical staff, and ensuring administrative, payroll, and compliance processes run smoothly.

The role suits someone who is organised, proactive, and capable of managing competing priorities in a multi-site business environment.

Key Responsibilities

Manage daily office operations and administrative systems

Supervise and support clerical and administrative staff

Oversee payroll preparation, timesheets, and leave administration

Coordinate accounts payable, receivable, and invoice processing

Maintain accurate records, filing systems, and documentation

Liaise with external service providers including accountants, bookkeepers, and suppliers

Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures

Assist with budgeting, reporting, and internal controls

Coordinate recruitment administration and onboarding processes

Support senior management with administrative and operational tasks

Maintain office resources, supplies, and equipment

Essential Criteria

At least 3 years’ experience in an office management, administration management, or senior administrative role

Experience supervising or coordinating administrative staff

Strong organisational, planning, and time management skills

High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Proficient in office software and business systems (e.g. accounting, payroll, or ERP systems)

Ability to work independently and take ownership of office operations

Desirable (but not essential)

Experience working in regional or remote operations

Experience in retail, logistics, or distribution environments

Experience with MYOB or similar accounting systems

Pre-Employment Requirements

National Police Check (acceptable outcome)

Right to work in Australia (or eligibility for employer sponsorship under a Designated Area Migration Agreement)

How to Apply

Applicants should submit a resume and a brief cover letter outlining their relevant experience and suitability for the role.

About the Client
Our client is seeking a compassionate Community Worker to deliver holistic support that empowers clients to achieve independence and wellbeing. You will work within a collaborative team, assessing needs, coordinating services, and advocating for vulnerable individuals across the community.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Conduct comprehensive client assessments to identify physical, emotional, social, and financial needs; then develop, implement, and review individualized support and education plans.

• Prepare funding submissions, grant applications, and detailed reports for government bodies and other agencies.

Requirements
• Diploma or higher in community services, social work, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
• Minimum one-year relevant experience in community services, social work, or disability support.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust with diverse clients and stakeholders.
• Knowledge of the NDIS, aged care, and mental health sectors is highly regarded.
• Current driver’s license and valid working with children check.

Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $90,000 - $95,000 p/a plus Super
Employer Name: Unique Wrought Iron Australia - T/a MICA BROS PTY LTD
A.B.N. 63 686 723 320
Job Location: 12 International Square, Tullamarine, VIC, 3043,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 13 Jul 2026 > 10 Aug 2026

Please include Reference: J1694-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client MICA BROS PTY LTD is seeking to add Welder (First Class) to its specialist wrought iron and architectural metalwork team in Tullamarine, Victoria. The business delivers custom-made gates, staircases, balustrades, decorative ironwork and luxury home features, managing design, fabrication, finishing, delivery and installation in-house with a strong focus on precision, durability and craftsmanship.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Interpret drawings, specifications and work instructions for custom wrought iron projects.
- Measure, mark and prepare steel components for fabrication and installation.
- Perform MIG and TIG welding on mild steel and stainless steel.
- Fabricate wrought iron gates, fences, balustrades, handrails and security doors.
- Cut, shape and form metal sections using appropriate tools and machinery.
- Align and assemble components using clamps, jigs and measuring instruments.
- Complete on-site measurements and modifications to ensure accurate final fitment.
- Inspect welds for strength, penetration, alignment, finish and overall quality.
- Grind, polish, smooth and finish welded joints to required standards.
- Apply safe work practices when handling tools, machinery and metal materials.
- Assist with professional delivery and installation of completed metalwork products.
- Coordinate with builders, supervisors and clients during fabrication and installation stages.
- Maintain fabrication equipment, tools and work areas in safe operating condition.
- Follow Australian Standards, workplace procedures and WHS requirements at all times.
- Support high-quality workmanship across bespoke residential and architectural metalwork projects.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Certificate IV in Engineering or equivalent welding and fabrication qualification is required for this position.
- At least two years of relevant welding, fabrication or architectural metalwork experience is required.

Business Analyst – Preston VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with a long-established and successful furniture retailer based in Preston, VIC. The company specialises in premium indoor and outdoor furniture, including sofas, dining furniture, bedroom suites, recliners, and home décor. With multiple retail showrooms, a growing eCommerce presence, and a commitment to exceptional customer experiences, our client is seeking an experienced and qualified Business Analyst to support the continued growth and business transformation.

About the Role:

The new Business Analyst will work across retail, eCommerce, supply chain and operational functions. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver technology and operational initiatives that enhance efficiency, customer experience and business performance.

•	Tenure – The role is full time and ongoing.

•	Location – Preston VIC

•	Salary – Salary, negotiable in the range of $80k to $90k plus superannuation per annum.

Responsibilities will include:

•	Engage with stakeholders across the business to gather, document and analyse business requirements.

•	Review existing business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and automation.

•	Analyse sales, inventory, customer and operational data to support strategic decision-making.

•	Develop business cases, functional specifications, process maps and workflow documentation.

•	Liaise with software vendors, developers and internal stakeholders during system implementation and enhancement projects.

•	Support the implementation of ERP, CRM, eCommerce and other business systems.

•	Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate system testing activities.

•	Prepare reports, dashboards and performance metrics to support business objectives.

•	Assist with change management, user training and post-implementation reviews.

•	Ensure solutions align with business objectives and industry best practice.

To be successful in this role you will have:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst in a similar setting.

•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

•	Proficiency with specific software tools (e.g., ERP systems, WMS, TMS), data analysis tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms.

•	Experience documenting business requirements, process mapping and business process improvement.

•	Experience working with ERP, CRM, retail or eCommerce systems will be highly regarded.

•	Advanced communication and documentation skills.

•	A results-driven mindset with a focus on improving company outcomes while achieving personal and team objectives.

•	Ability to multitask and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.

•	Solid references.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

ABOUT US
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER
We are supporting a hospitality group (SXW Pty Ltd) based in Darwin that operates across several popular venues, specialising in Aussie-Italian and Aussie-Filipino fusion cuisine. The business is known for it's commitment to handcrafted meals, warm service, and consistent customer satisfaction. They are currently hiring for the following role: Cook. These roles offer a great opportunity to join a dynamic team and grow within a stable, fast-paced hospitality environment.

COOK
Job Overview:
As a Cook, you will prepare and cook a variety of dishes to a high standard, support inventory control, and maintain a clean and safe kitchen environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare meals according to recipes and presentation guidelines.
Ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency in food production.
Support stock management and assist with food ordering.
Follow food safety and hygiene protocols.

Requirements:
Certificate III in Commercial Cookery or equivalent.
1–2 years of cooking experience in a commercial setting.
Time management skills and shift flexibility.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
Competitive salary starting at $67,510 (with scope to increase based on experience)
Opportunities for internal advancement and skills training
Positive, inclusive work environment

HOW TO APPLY
We are looking for professionals who are passionate about hospitality and can demonstrate their experience clearly and confidently.

To apply, submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
Why you are applying for this position; and
An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a vibrant team and contributing to a high-quality hospitality experience, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in applications will not be accepted.
